mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id, c.name as category_name, p.status, p.sales, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY p.sales DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (name, description, price, stock, image, category_id, status, sales, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{categoryId}, #{status}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE product SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, image = #{image}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET stock = stock - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE product SET sales = sales + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.stock, p.image, p.category_id as categoryId, c.name as categoryName, p.status, p.sales as salesCount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(oi.subtotal) FROM order_item oi JOIN `order` o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE oi.product_id = p.id AND o.status >= 1 AND o.status != 4), 0) as salesAmount, p.create_time as createTime, p.update_time as updateTime FROM product p LEFT JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id WHERE p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sales DESC LIMIT #{limit}
